<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the monoisotopic peak at m/z 262.09938 corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral exact mass of 261.09210 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈20 % M+1, ≈2.3 % M+2) is consistent with ~18 carbons and two oxygens. The formula C₁₈H₁₃O₂ has an exact mass of 261.09155 Da (≈0.5 mDa from the measured value, ~2 ppm) and matches the observed isotopic distribution. Therefore the molecular formula is C18H13O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H13O2</final_answer>
